candidates.code:
import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(125.1, 60.7, 71.5)
    .faces(">Z")
    .fillet(1.9)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .center(0.0, 0.0)
    .rect(37.8, 127.1)
    .cutBlind(-29.3)
    .faces("<Z").workplane()
    .pushPoints([(50.55, 18.35), (-50.55, 18.35), (50.55, -18.35), (-50.55, -18.35)])
    .hole(6.2)
    .faces(">Y").workplane()
    .pushPoints([(31.275, 23.75), (-31.275, 23.75)])
    .hole(3.5, depth=11.9)
    .edges("|Z")
    .fillet(0.8)
    .faces(">Z").faces(">X")
    .workplane(centerOption="CenterOfMass")
    .circle(15.0)
    .extrude(14.0)
)
show_object(result)
